class.name: GameplayTagContainer
class.brief_description: A container for efficient GameplayTag storage and comparison.
class.description: Stores a list of [GameplayTag]s and provides efficient methods to check for matching, overlapping, or presence of tags. Useful for implementing "Has Any Tag", "Has All Tags" logic.

method.name: add_tag
method.description: Adds a tag to the container by name.

method.name: has_all
method.description: Returns true if this container holds ALL the tags present in the [param other] container.

method.name: has_any
method.description: Returns true if this container holds ANY of the tags present in the [param other] container.

method.name: has_tag
method.description: Returns true if the container holds the specified tag (by name). Handles hierarchy matching.

method.name: remove_tag
method.description: Removes a tag from the container by name.
